bosses.name: Kirtonos the Herald
bosses.general: Called with the Blood of Innocents at the balcony brazier. Bat form: swoops, Disarm, Wing Flap. Humanoid form: Curse of Tongues, Shadow Bolt Volley, Dominate Mind.
bosses.tank: Hold him and pick him back up after each form change.
bosses.healer: Decurse, dispel the mind control, heal the volley.
bosses.dps: Burn him; casters decurse between casts.

bosses.name: Jandice Barov
bosses.general: Splits into many illusions: the real Jandice is the one that takes damage. Curse of Blood.
bosses.tank: Grab the illusions with area threat.
bosses.dps: Find the real one and burn her; area attacks clear the illusions.

bosses.name: Rattlegore
bosses.general: Huge bone golem: War Stomp and Knock Away.

bosses.name: Marduk Blackpool
bosses.general: Viewing room event with Vectus: Shadow Bolt Volley and Cleave; students come in waves first.

bosses.name: Vectus
bosses.general: Viewing room event: Fire Nova and Flamestrike.
bosses.tank: Hold him away from the group.

bosses.name: Ras Frostwhisper
bosses.general: Lich: Frostbolt, Frost Nova, Chill Nova, Knock Away. Fire works well on him.

bosses.name: Instructor Malicia
bosses.general: Heal, Renew and Corruption; she calls the dead.

bosses.name: Doctor Theolen Krastinov
bosses.general: The Butcher: hits hard with Rend and Frenzy.
bosses.dps: Hunters Tranquilizing Shot the frenzy; burn him.

bosses.name: Lorekeeper Polkelt
bosses.general: Corrosive Acid and Noxious Catalyst, a disease that bursts on the people around.

bosses.name: The Ravenian
bosses.tank: Face it away from the group.

bosses.name: Lord Alexei Barov
bosses.general: Unholy Aura burns everyone around him; Corruption.

bosses.name: Lady Illucia Barov
bosses.general: Shadow Shock, a fear and Curse of Agony.

bosses.name: Darkmaster Gandling
bosses.general: Shadow Portal sends a player into one of the side rooms full of undead, the door locks until they die. Arcane Missiles and a curse.
bosses.tank: Hold him; if you're ported, tank the room's undead and come back.
bosses.healer: Decurse; whoever is ported needs heals, go to the door.
bosses.dps: Burn him; help a ported friend clear the room.
